intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in The Woodlands for 2026, and here is what he found: 9 family events, at least 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Holiday on the Waterway) through January 3, 2027 (Holiday on the Waterway), with December 4 (Waterway Winter Nights), December 5 (Christmas Fest at The Woodlands Methodist Church) and December 13 (Sensory Santa at The Woodlands Children's Museum) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in The Woodlands

  • 9 Christmas events for kids in The Woodlands
  • At least 2 free events, including Waterway Winter Nights and Christmas Fest at The Woodlands Methodist Church
  • Meet Santa: Photos with Santa at Market Street, Sensory Santa at The Woodlands Children's Museum, Stories with Santa
  • Lights and fireworks: Holiday on the Waterway, Market Street in Lights, Waterway Winter Nights on three Fridays in December
  • Trains: train rides at Christmas Fest at The Woodlands Methodist Church
  • Season: November 21 to January 3, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? The Woodlands families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
